validationRequirements: All instance IDs, bindings, placement targets, invokers, and fallback references must resolve.
Place types are optional slots; required counts and permitted nesting belong to a family recipe.
Resolve container form separately from semantic place and position.
Reject ambiguous reference spaces, conflicting placements, and dependency cycles.
Spatial registrations must declare units, axes, orientation, reference identity, and attachment behavior.
Preserve application identity and state only through explicit representation mappings.
Validate interaction and fallback capability; a name alone does not grant behavior.
No new family or place ID is accepted by current data attributes or the compact URL codec solely because it appears here.
